get.description:
Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time message delivery.
Authentication is handled by the Gin middleware chain — the JWT token
must be provided in the `Authorization` header, identical to HTTP endpoints.

Once connected, the client receives push events for message activity
in conversations where they participate. No query parameters are needed;
conversation filtering happens at publish time based on the sender's context.

**Event format:**
```json
{
  "type": "conversation.message.created",
  "conversation_id": 123,
  "message": {
    "id": 456,
    "sender_role": "consumer",
    "content": "Hola, necesito un presupuesto",
    "created_on": "2026-06-04T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

101.description: Switching Protocols — WebSocket connection upgraded successfully

401.description: Unauthorized — Missing or invalid JWT token

BearerAuth.description: Auth0-issued JWT. The API uses the token subject claim as the internal auth identifier.

RegisterConsumerRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /consumers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from all string fields before validation/persistence.

email.description: Consumer email. Must match the server email validation regex.

name.description: Consumer given name or display name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Consumer surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

RegisterProviderRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /providers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from email, name, and surname before validation/persistence. category_id and profile_photo_file_id are required by the domain service. coverage_zone is currently accepted by the request struct but ignored by the service.

email.description: Provider email. Must match the server email validation regex.

name.description: Provider given name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Provider surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

coverage_zone.description: Accepted by JSON binding for backwards compatibility, but the current handler does not pass this value to the provider service and it is not persisted.

profile_photo_file_id.description: Confirmed provider profile photo file identifier returned by the file upload flow.

category_id.description: Existing category identifier for the provider. Missing or zero values return "Category id is required"; unknown ids return "Category does not exist".

ProviderSummary.description: Provider summary returned after provider registration and by GET /providers when filtering by category_id.

PresignFileRequest.description: Request a direct upload URL for a file that will later be associated with a business resource.

original_name.description: Original file name selected by the user.

mime_type.description: File MIME type. Provider profile photos accept image/jpeg, image/png, and image/webp.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Provider profile photos must not exceed 5 MB.

purpose.description: Intended business use for the file.

file_id.description: API file identifier to use when confirming the upload and associating the file.

key.description: Storage object key generated by the API.

upload_url.description: URL where the client uploads the file bytes directly.

headers.description: Headers the client must include when uploading the file bytes.
